question.problem:
$$
[\begin{aligned}a & b \\ -5 & -2\end{aligned}]
$$

The matrix of the bilinear form $B(x,y)=-4{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+3{x}_{1}{y}_{2}-5{x}_{2}{y}_{1}-2{x}_{2}{y}_{2}$ is given above. What is the value of $a+b?$
question.worked_solution:
Each term ${a}_{ij}{x}_{i}{y}_{j}$ in the expression of the bilinear form corresponds to the entry ${a}_{ij}$ of the matrix:

$$
\begin{aligned}B(x,y) & =-4{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+3{x}_{1}{y}_{2}-5{x}_{2}{y}_{1}-2{x}_{2}{y}_{2} \\  & =(-4){x}_{1}{y}_{1}+\,\,3{x}_{1}{y}_{2} \\  & +\,(-5){x}_{2}{y}_{1}\,+(-2){x}_{2}{y}_{2}\end{aligned}
$$

   

Then, the corresponding matrix of the bilinear form is

$$
[\begin{aligned}-4 & 3 \\ -5 & -2\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, $a=-4$ and $b=3.$ Finally, 

$$
a+b=-4+3=-1.
$$
